_rule: Written and committed BEFORE the run (2026-11-02). One observable per trend gate: the tail (cycles 20-22) against the baseline (cycles 2-4) of the same launch. null = no growth predicted: the tail median within the baseline max + its own spread + the print precision (scripts/queue_gates.py trend_failures). Cycle 1 is excluded because the camera loop sees each view there first (mesh cache, hit-material pool and shader cache fill).

vram_used_mb.basis: every pool of the layer is sized at start or grows by demand and is reused (mesh pool LRU, rt_xfb_mb fixed, hit-material buffer reuse rt_hit_material_recycle=1, water records fixed); the same 100 s loop asks for the same demand after cycle 1

mesh_pool_mb.basis: same views every cycle: no new meshes after cycle 1; audits evict and rebuild in place (rt_mesh_audits=2)

as_mb.basis: static BLAS built once per mesh; per-draw BLAS refit; compaction keeps AS at the compacted size

frame_time_median_ms.basis: no per-frame work scales with session length; smoke_ultra median 16.65 ms at S8 for scale

frame_time_p99_ms.basis: as the median; no growing hitch source known (shader cache warm after cycle 1)

hit_material_pool_records.basis: records follow the drawn set, evicted with their mesh; same set every cycle

scene_wait_timeouts.basis: gated 0 in every lean cost window since the scene-wait fix (smoke_ultra valid 2026-11-02)

capture_drops.basis: capture buffers follow the scene (rt_xfb_mb, cascade grows on demand); camp passed in cb1 and gf1

log_mb.basis: ~3 KB/s default plus rt_timing_frames=120 cost lines and 22 x 10 s rt_stats windows; below the 64 MB rotation cap ([log] reached is forbidden)

disk_mb.basis: no traces or dumps: the log and the runner files only
